components.name: Trace Action
components.description: Primary full-width action for resolving the selected city pair.
components.html: <button class="ds-trace-action"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="5" cy="17" r="2.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/><circle cx="19" cy="7" r="2.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M7.2 15.6 16.8 8.4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>Trace route</button>
components.css: .ds-trace-action { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; width:100%; min-height:50px; padding:12px 16px; color:#fff; background:var(--ink); border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:8px; font:800 14px/1.55 Avenir,"Avenir Next",Futura,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.14); transition:transform 140ms ease,background 140ms ease; } .ds-trace-action svg { width:18px; height:18px; } .ds-trace-action:hover { background:#163d68; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-trace-action:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-trace-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1769d2; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-trace-action:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:wait; transform:none; }

components.name: City Select
components.description: Native city picker with a compact instrument label and large target.
components.css: .ds-city-field { color:#405b72; font:800 10px/1.2 Avenir,"Avenir Next",Futura,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-city-field select { display:block; width:100%; height:48px; margin-top:8px; padding:0 36px 0 13px; color:var(--ink); background:#fff; border:1px solid #aebfc7; border-radius:8px; font:400 14px/1.55 Avenir,"Avenir Next",Futura,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-city-field select:hover { border-color:#718a98; } .ds-city-field select:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1769d2; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Quiet underlined action for mode changes and map fitting.
components.css: .ds-text-action { padding:0; color:#315878; background:none; border:0; font:400 12px/1.4 Avenir,"Avenir Next",Futura,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:3px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-text-action:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1769d2; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Route Choice
components.description: Numbered candidate card whose accent stays tied to route order.
components.css: .ds-route-choice { --route-color:#ed542d; display:grid; grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr); gap:14px; width:100%; min-height:92px; padding:0 15px 0 0; overflow:hidden; color:var(--ink); background:rgba(255,255,255,.58); border:1px solid #bac8ce; border-radius:9px; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; opacity:.8; transition:opacity 140ms ease,transform 140ms ease,box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-route-choice:hover { opacity:1; transform:translateX(2px); } .ds-route-choice:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1769d2; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-route-choice.is-selected { opacity:1; border-color:var(--route-color); background:#fff; } .ds-route-number { align-self:stretch; display:grid; place-items:center; color:#fff; background:var(--route-color); font:800 28px/1 Avenir,"Avenir Next",Futura,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-route-body { align-self:center; min-width:0; padding:12px 0; } .ds-route-kicker { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color:var(--route-color); font:800 10px/1.2 Avenir,"Avenir Next",Futura,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-route-kicker small { font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-route-body strong { display:block; margin-top:5px; font:600 17px/1.18 "Downlink Display",ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; } .ds-route-metrics { display:block; margin-top:8px; color:var(--muted); font:400 11px/1.3 Avenir,"Avenir Next",Futura,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; }

components.name: Infrastructure Legend
components.description: Text-first key distinguishing mapped submarine spans from modeled terrestrial connections.

components.name: Map Route Badge
components.description: Color-keyed map marker that grows only for the selected candidate.
components.css: .ds-route-badge { --route-color:#ed542d; display:grid; place-items:center; width:24px; height:24px; color:#fff; background:var(--route-color); border:2px solid rgba(250,249,244,.96); border-radius:6px; box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.2); font:800 11px/1 ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; opacity:.8; } .ds-route-badge.is-selected { width:29px; height:29px; font-size:13px; opacity:1; }

narrative.overview:
Downlink is a pale working chart: mineral-blue water, chalk land, navy instrument ink, and fine rules make route evidence feel plotted rather than decorated. The interface is restrained, technical, and daylight-legible, with the comparison ledger and geography reading as one continuous work surface.

Color carries meaning instead of atmosphere. Three stable route marks keep alternatives comparable, solid and dashed geometry separates mapped submarine infrastructure from modeled land connections, and motion belongs only to the selected signal.
keyCharacteristics: Light nautical chart palette with high-contrast navy notation
Condensed display type paired with plain controls and monospaced map annotations
Fixed planning ledger beside a dominant interactive map
Persistent candidate context with selected-only motion

rules.name: The Route Identity Rule
rules.body: Candidate order owns the vermilion, cobalt, and sea-green sequence everywhere; do not reuse those colors as interchangeable decoration.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for identity and route naming, ordinary sans-serif for operation, and monospace only where text behaves like map or telemetry notation.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows may separate working layers or protect controls from the map; they do not turn the ledger into a pile of floating cards.

dos: Do keep the map visually dominant and the route ledger contiguous with the viewport edge.
Do preserve candidate color by route order across cards, badges, paths, landings, and animation.
Do pair every infrastructure line style with explicit text and keep inference language visible.
Do honor reduced motion and preserve visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't convert the light chart table into a dark monitoring dashboard or a pile of floating glass cards.
Don't animate inactive routes or hide alternatives when one route is selected.
Don't imply that modeled terrestrial paths, candidate cables, or latency floors are measured packet routes.
Don't add geographic labels until they come from a verified local dataset.
